scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and executable deterministic checks distinguish asymptotic statements from finite quadrature; same-model review only.
scientific_limitations: Requires one-dimensional randomly accelerated motion with simultaneous Poisson resets of both position and velocity to zero.
Fixed positive diffusivity and resetting rate; far-field stationary snapshot conditional on exact nonzero position, not first-passage or level-crossing conditioning.
Results are asymptotic and use the published exact stationary joint-mixture formula as a premise; publication-priority assessment of implicit derivations remains open.
No external independent audit or publication claim is implied.
title: Extreme-displacement velocity and reset-age laws for random acceleration
